scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof; independent labeled subset enumeration tests; all-r sharpness is analytical. Known total-positivity theory is fully credited, and no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite known species abundances; uniform without-replacement sampling; species-constant traits; mean over sampled individuals. Does not cover trait means averaged over detected species or correlated detection. Bibliographic novelty needs independent verification, especially incomplete technical texts.
title: A sharp variation-diminishing law for richness–trait covariance under finite rarefaction
